title: etwdump: Show human-readable Win32 error messages
description:
The ETW capture code reported Win32 API failures as raw hexadecimal
error codes, which are hard to interpret. For example, starting a live
capture without administrator rights produced:

    etw_dump failed: StartTrace failed with 0x5.

The plain "0x5" gives the user no idea what actually went wrong.

Pass the error code through win32strerror(), which renders the system
message text alongside the numeric code. The same failure now reads:

    etw_dump failed: StartTrace failed: Access is denied. (5)

making the cause obvious at a glance.

Apply the same treatment to the StartTrace, EnableTraceEx2, OpenTrace,
ProcessTrace and provider-GUID lookup failures. Also fix the
EnableTraceEx2 message that named the wrong function, and set *err on
the previously unset "Unknown scenario" error path so it no longer
returns a stale error code.

AI-Assisted: yes (Claude Opus 4.8)
